description: This file contains an abstract class 'BaseAbstractUnivariateSolver' that provides a base implementation for univariate function solvers. It manages evaluation counting, accuracy parameters, setup, and utility methods for root-finding algorithms, meant to be extended by specific solver implementations.

classes.name: BaseAbstractUnivariateSolver
classes.description: Abstract base class for univariate solvers, providing common functionality and utility methods, to be extended by specific solver implementations.

methods.name: getMaxEvaluations
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of function evaluations allowed.

methods.name: getEvaluations
methods.description: Returns the number of function evaluations performed so far.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the search interval.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the search interval.

methods.name: getStartValue
methods.description: Returns the initial guess for the root.

methods.name: getFunctionValueAccuracy
methods.description: Returns the function value accuracy parameter.

methods.name: computeObjectiveValue
methods.description: Evaluates the function at a given point, incrementing the evaluation count.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the solver with the function, interval, start value, and maximum evaluations.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Entry point for solving the root-finding problem with specified parameters.

methods.name: doSolve
methods.description: Abstract method to implement actual solving logic in subclasses.

methods.name: isBracketing
methods.description: Checks if the function takes opposite signs at the endpoints.

methods.name: isSequence
methods.description: Checks if three values form a strictly increasing sequence.

methods.name: verifyInterval
methods.description: Verifies that the interval bounds are valid.

methods.name: verifySequence
methods.description: Verifies that the sequence of three values is strictly increasing.

methods.name: verifyBracketing
methods.description: Verifies if the interval brackets a root, i.e., the function has opposite signs at the endpoints.

methods.name: incrementEvaluationCount
methods.description: Increments the evaluation counter, throws exception if maximum is exceeded.
